user.title: Catalog editor
user.description:
Add and edit entries of the catalogs. They are usable at once by the integrations that read them.

To **propose** entries to the catalog (pull requests), the editor needs the Client ID of a GitHub OAuth App of yours. Create it in one minute:

1. Open [github.com/settings/applications/new](https://github.com/settings/applications/new) (sign in to GitHub if asked).
2. *Application name*: anything (e.g. `Catalog editor`). *Homepage URL* and *Authorization callback URL*: any address, e.g. `https://github.com/Elwinmage/catalog-editor` (they are not used).
3. Tick **Enable Device Flow**, then click **Register application**.
4. Copy the **Client ID** shown on the next page (no secret is needed) and paste it below.

data.client_id: Client ID of the GitHub OAuth App

init.title: Catalogs and image model
init.description: Photos of species (reeftank): the editor can ask an image model for the photo of a species, with **your own** API key (the cost is yours). The key is never shown again; leave it empty to keep the stored one (currently: {key_state}).
